goal: Add a new mock-server route mock-server/routes/qms_tr.js modeled on sync.js's job_id/steps/download pattern (not mtr.js's run_id pattern), covering create/poll/download/list + an error-path simulation, and register it in server.js.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /qms_tr/runs creates a run for a country (brasil) + ano_base, returns 201 with a synthetic job_id, and starts step progression (steps default pending/running).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: POST /qms_tr/runs with {country:'brasil', ano_base:2025} -> 201, body has job_id, country, ano_base, steps array with names [silver_builder, kpis_batch, export_zip].

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /qms_tr/runs/{id} returns status + steps, and steps advance as time passes (same interval mechanism as sync.js, MOCK_STEP_INTERVAL_MS-driven), eventually reaching status completed.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest with a short MOCK_STEP_INTERVAL_MS: create run, poll GET /qms_tr/runs/{id} repeatedly (with waits) until status === 'completed'; assert all steps completed in order.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /qms_tr/{tag_or_id}/download returns a downloadable file (zip or csv) once the run is completed, and 409s if not yet finished.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: call download before completion -> 409/job_not_finished; after completion -> 200 with Content-Disposition attachment header, resolvable by either job_id or tag.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /qms_tr/runs?country=... lists/filters runs for history use.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: create 2 runs (different countries), GET /qms_tr/runs?country=brasil returns only the brasil one(s).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An error path is simulable: a run can be forced to fail at a step (deterministic, not just 5% random) so the frontend error handling can be tested.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: create a run with a force-fail flag (e.g. force_outcome:'fail' in POST body), poll until status === 'failed', assert the failed step has status failed + error message, and job.status/job.error reflect the failure.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New route is registered in mock-server/server.js the same way sync.js/mtr.js are, reachable under /api/v1/qms_tr/*.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep server.js for qms_tr import + app.use; vitest hits the route mounted the same way trigger-fields.test.js does for sync.js.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server/routes/sync.js and mock-server/routes/mtr.js are untouched (read-only reference); existing mock-server tests keep passing.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: git diff numerator/develop -- mock-server/routes/sync.js mock-server/routes/mtr.js is empty; npm test (vitest run) full suite green.

tasks.desc: Write failing vitest for qms_tr.js route (create/poll/download/list/error path) against a fresh express app mounting only qms_tr router

Implement mock-server/routes/qms_tr.js: in-memory job store keyed by job_id, steps [silver_builder, kpis_batch, export_zip] with a comment that names must sync with the real backend later, setInterval-driven progression mirroring sync.js, force_outcome fail/pass override
Register qms_tr router in mock-server/server.js next to sync/mtr imports
Run full VERIFY_CMD (npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b) and confirm mock-server suite green
